documents.text: High-risk customer review: a high-risk customer requires manual analyst review before onboarding.
Customer clearance screening: clearance requires a completed screening result with status CLEAR. A pending screening result cannot support clearance.
Screening evidence retention: keep screening results and analyst decisions for five years.
Sanctions screening escalation: escalate a possible sanctions match to the compliance team. Keep the customer pending until the match is resolved.
Employee travel: submit expense receipts within thirty days.

questions.question: What high-risk customer review and customer clearance screening are required before onboarding?
questions.reference: A high-risk customer requires manual analyst review before onboarding. Clearance requires a completed screening result with status CLEAR.

questions.question: What customer clearance screening status is required, and how long is screening evidence retention?
questions.reference: Clearance requires a completed screening result with status CLEAR. Screening results and analyst decisions must be kept for five years.

questions.question: What sanctions screening escalation is required for a possible match, and what screening evidence retention applies?
questions.reference: Escalate a possible sanctions match to the compliance team and keep the customer pending until resolution. Keep screening results and analyst decisions for five years.
